title: Seeing small numbers at a glance without counting
examples: How can I see how many without counting?
How do I know it is seven without counting?

explain.say: Look at the board. How many dots can you see? There are 3 dots. You can see 3 without counting one by one. Seeing how many with one quick look is called subitising.

draw.text: Seeing small numbers at a glance without counting

explain.say: Now there are 4 dots. Your eyes can see 4 without counting. Can you hold up 4 fingers?
Here are 5 dots. One row of the frame is full. A full row is always 5. When you see a full row, you know it is 5. Can you clap 5 times?
Now there are 7 dots. Look at the full row of 5. Then look at the 2 more. 5 and 2 make 7. Can you see the 5 inside the 7?
Here are 9 dots. You can see a full row of 5 and 4 more. 9 is also 1 less than a full frame of 10. Today, roll a dice with a grown-up. Say how many dots before you count them.

faq.a: Subitising means knowing how many things there are just by looking, without counting one by one. Most people can do it for up to about four things.

faq.q: How do I see bigger numbers quickly?
faq.a: Look for small groups inside. Seven can be a row of five and two more. Your eyes put the groups together.
asks: How do I see seven fast?

faq.q: Why does a full row help?
faq.a: A ten frame row holds five. When you see a full row, you know it is five. Then you only look at the extra dots.
asks: Tell me about the ten frame

faq.a: Dice games, dominoes and dot cards are perfect. Say the number before you count, then check.

faq.q: What if I still need to count?
faq.a: That is fine. Counting is a good skill too. With practice, you will see more amounts at once. A grown-up can play quick-look games with you.

facts: Most people can tell up to about four objects at a glance without counting.
A ten frame has two rows of five spaces, so it holds ten counters.

quiz.say: Look at a ten frame. How many dots fit in one full row?
quiz.show: A full row of a ten frame holds how many?
quiz.why: A ten frame has 2 rows. Each row holds 5 dots.

wrong.0: 4 dots leave 1 space empty in the row.
wrong.2: 10 dots fill both rows of the frame.

quiz.say: Mei sees 5 dots in a row and 2 more. How many dots are there?
quiz.why: A full row is 5. 5 and 2 more make 7.

wrong.0: 5 is the full row on its own.
